aboutPage.title: ❤️ About Wifey for Lifey
aboutPage.subtitle: We're not just here for your wedding—we're here for your womanhood.
aboutPage.introP1: <brand>Wifey for Lifey</brand> was born from one deep truth: planning a wedding is one of the most emotional journeys a woman takes—and no one was doing enough to emotionally support her through it. So we stepped in—not just with pretty planners, but with genuine guidance, heartfelt sisterhood, and practical tools that help her feel calm, clear, and confident.
aboutPage.introP2: But here's the thing: we're not stopping at weddings.
aboutPage.introP3: We believe a woman's story doesn't end when she says "I do." It's just beginning. That's why <brand>Wifey for Lifey</brand> is evolving into an empowerment-driven lifestyle brand—one that supports women not just as brides, but as humans building homes, careers, families, and futures.
aboutPage.whyP1: To guide, support, and celebrate women through every stage of life—starting with her wedding, and growing with her through everything that comes next.
aboutPage.whyP2: We want to build a <highlight>womanhood empowerment empire</highlight>—yes, empire—where our content, products, and experiences uplift, equip, and emotionally support women with realness, warmth, and wisdom.
aboutPage.offerStressFreeDesc: Through our detailed planners and heartfelt content, we help brides navigate the chaos with calm, clarity, and confidence.
aboutPage.offerEmotionalDesc: We listen deeply and create tools that support not just logistics—but also her heart.
aboutPage.offerWomenOwnedDesc: We collaborate with local women-owned businesses and spotlight their magic.
aboutPage.offerSisterhoodDesc: From planning a wedding to planning her baby shower, <brand>Wifey for Lifey</brand> grows with her.
aboutPage.valueEmpathyDesc: We listen with intention. Whether she's a bride, a business owner, or a mother-to-be—every woman deserves to feel heard, seen, and supported without judgment.
aboutPage.valueEmpowermentDesc: We're not here to fix her—we're here to remind her she's powerful. Our content, tools, and community are designed to build confidence, clarity, and calm.
aboutPage.valuePersonalizationDesc: No two love stories—or life journeys—are the same. We tailor our experiences to honor her uniqueness, from her budget to her big dreams.
aboutPage.valueHonestyDesc: We speak truth gently. No fluff. No fake pressure. Just real, thoughtful advice that helps her make informed decisions, not impulsive ones.
aboutPage.valueThoughtfulnessDesc: Every product, post, and package is crafted with care. From the way we design our planner to the tone in our voice notes—we obsess over the little things because they matter.
aboutPage.valueWomenForWomenDesc: We actively champion women-owned businesses, creatives, and voices—because when women rise together, we all win.
aboutPage.promiseP1: Whether you’re planning your big day, starting a new chapter, or just trying to hold it all together—we’ve got you. With honest support, meaningful products, and a community that feels like home.
aboutPage.promiseP2: Welcome to your safe space, your planning partner, and your lifelong hype squad.
